notes: Woodcliff Lake: DCA obligation was 441 prospective need; court-fixed at 360 (May 13, 2025, Judge Corriston). Present need = 0. Original June 2025 HEFSP adopted with 66-unit RDP. Challenged by both FSHC and SIG 100 Tice. Settlement reached December 16, 2025; plan amended February 11, 2026, adopted March 16, 2026. Amended plan increases RDP to 131 units; unmet need = 229. Note: Program Settlement Recommendation shows final accounting with RDP = 97 effective credits (94 + 3 bonus) from the RDP sites, with 131 being the theoretical VLA RDP. RDP satisfied by: (1) BMW Redevelopment - Block 602, Lot 1: 370 units, 34 family + 40 supportive = 74 affordable (34 family AH + bonus credits, 4 of 40 supportive apply to RDP = 48 credits); (2) Hilton Redevelopment - Block 301, Lot 3.04 (200 Tice Blvd): 147 units, 30 for-sale affordable + 15 bonus = 45 credits; (3) 240 Broadway - Block 2601, Lots 15 and 16: 63 units, 12 affordable + 6 transit bonus = 18 credits; (4) 126 Broadway: 8 units, 2 affordable + 1 bonus = 3 credits; (5) 230 Broadway surplus: 4 special needs credits; (6) Waterfront Boarding House: 13 transitional beds. Unmet need addressed by: BMW (36 supportive units), THOH Overlay - Block 908, Lot 2 (88 Overlook Drive, ~4 affordable at 20% set-aside), and 100 Tice Boulevard/Block 301, Lot 3.05 (SIG 100 Tice: 91 total units, 18 age-restricted affordable, plus 73 market-rate townhouses and retail). Also: North Broadway overlay zones and Teva overlay at Block 402, Lot 2 addressed prior round unmet need.

sites.adoption_status: redevelopment plan adopted July 21, 2025; not yet constructed
sites.quote: BMW Redevelopment. The Borough adopted a Redevelopment Plan on July 21, 2025 for the former BMW Headquarters property at Block 602, Lot 1, which permits 370 units inclusive of 34 affordable family units and 40 supportive housing units, for a combined 74 affordable units.
sites.notes: 34 family AH units + 10 redevelopment bonus credits = 44 credits toward RDP; 4 supportive housing units also toward RDP; 36 remaining supportive units toward unmet need. Total 48 RDP credits + 36 unmet need credits from this site.

sites.site_name: Hilton Redevelopment (former Hilton Hotel, 200 Tice Boulevard)
sites.proposed_zoning: Redevelopment Plan (to be adopted by March 16, 2026)
sites.adoption_status: redevelopment plan pending adoption (per amendment plan)
sites.quote: Hilton Redevelopment Plan. As stated in the Adopted HEFSP, a Redevelopment Plan will be adopted on or before March 16, 2026 which will permit the redevelopment of Block 301, Lot 3.04 (200 Tice Boulevard) to permit 147 housing units, of which 30 units will be affordable.
sites.notes: 30 for-sale affordable + 15 bonus = 45 credits toward RDP. Plan amendment notes this is the plan's for-sale component, satisfying 25% rental minimum requirement noted.

sites.address: 240 Broadway (with 258 and 264 Broadway), Woodcliff Lake, NJ
sites.adoption_status: redevelopment plan pending; originally LUB approved 41 units/7 AH January 28, 2025
sites.quote: The developer has since gained control of adjacent properties at 258 and 264 Broadway, and now includes the totality of Lots 15 and 16 on Block 2601. The Borough will proceed with a redevelopment plan which will permit a total of 63 dwelling units on the newly expanded tract, which will include 12 affordable units.
sites.notes: 12 affordable + 6 transit bonus = 18 credits toward RDP. Adjacent to Woodcliff Lake NJ Transit rail station.

sites.quote: 126 Broadway. As stated in the Adopted HEFSP, eight (8) apartments have been approved at this property, inclusive of two (2) affordable units, which are eligible for 0.5 transit oriented bonus credits per affordable unit, for a total of one (1) bonus credit and a cumulative three (3) credits toward the RDP.
sites.notes: 2 affordable + 1 transit bonus = 3 credits toward RDP. Block/lot not specified in plan text.

sites.site_name: THOH Townhouse Overlay Zone (88 Overlook Drive)
sites.adoption_status: overlay zone created 2022; not yet constructed
sites.quote: THOII Overlay. The THO Townhouse Overlay Zone, created in 2022 on Block 908, Lot 2 (88 Overlook Drive), will be credited towards the unmet need. The Plan anticipates a yield of four affordable (4) units at full build-out based upon a 20% affordable housing set-aside.
sites.notes: Counts toward unmet need satisfaction, not RDP. 20% set-aside, ~4 affordable units anticipated.

sites.site_name: 100 Tice Boulevard (SIG 100 Tice / Party City building)
sites.mechanism: inclusionary overlay (new zone per settlement with SIG 100 Tice)
sites.adoption_status: overlay ordinance to be adopted per settlement (March 2026 deadline)
sites.quote: Tice is the owner of a 12.9-acre property at 100 Tice Boulevard, a.k.a. Block 301, Lot 3.05... 100 Tice Boulevard. The Borough will adopt an ordinance permitting the creation of no more than 91 total units inclusive of no less than 18 age-restricted affordable units.
sites.notes: Settlement with SIG 100 Tice: 73 market-rate townhouses (25 age-targeted carriage units) + 18 affordable age-restricted apartments above ~20,000 sq ft retail. $300,000 contribution to AH trust fund. Counts toward unmet need. 18 age-restricted units are within 30% age-restricted cap.
